author: Riley
name: DeepSeek
short: Chat with DeepSeek via !ai or by mentioning the bot.
description: Adds a DeepSeek-backed AI assistant. Ask with the `ai` command, or just mention the bot, reply to one of its messages, or use a configured AI channel where no prefix is required. Per-channel conversation context, configurable model, system prompt, history depth and token limits. Requires a DeepSeek API key set with `[p]set api deepseek api_key <key>`.
end_user_data_statement: Conversation context is kept in memory only and is not written to disk. Prompts and responses are sent to the DeepSeek API for processing.
